summary.decision_summary: Pat Pidgeon won by 55.2. Pat Pidgeon left 10.0 lineup points on the table, while ZSzizzle left 57.2.
summary.historical_summary: This is the first recorded meeting between these managers. Pat Pidgeon leads the manager series 1-0.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Pat Pidgeon
summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 55.2, led by a 36.8-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Jahmyr Gibbs (31.8) and Chuba Hubbard (23.9).
summary.loser_reason: ZSzizzle could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 36.8 points. Jeremiyah Love scored 3.3. Its best legal lineup added 57.2, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
